notes: The probe previously awaited response.clone().text() for EVERY response before returning it to the frontend, so a streamed generate response was fully buffered before the fetch promise resolved: incremental rendering was impossible to observe and an aborted stream observed an empty message. That was a probe defect on both legs (rule 10), fixed by skipping the clone read for text/event-stream and for the generate route. Earlier captures in this directory were taken with that defect; these captures are not.
The peer records clientDisconnected only when the caller closes before the scripted stream finishes; it is the provider-side proof of cancellation.
framesWritten in cancellation mode depends on how many paced frames were written before the abort arrived, so it is recorded for information, not asserted.
Pinned emits extra prompt-manager dry generations (visible as duplicate GENERATE_AFTER_DATA dryRun=true entries); they never issue a provider request and are not part of the comparison.
